entities.name: bL17 ribosomal protein
observations: The 126-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein A0L5Z9 from Magnetococcus marinus.
Pfam identifies Ribosomal_L17 (PF01196.25) at positions 20–117 with i-Evalue 8.2e-40.
The protein is strongly basic: predicted pI 10.592 and charge at pH 7 of approximately +12.95.
Reviewed homolog annotations assign it to the 50S large ribosomal subunit, where it contacts L32.
Associated Gene Ontology terms are structural constituent of ribosome, cytosolic large ribosomal subunit, and translation.

entities.name: Bacterial translation
observations: bL17 is a structural component of the bacterial 50S ribosomal subunit and participates in translation.

entities.name: Bacterial cytosol
observations: The protein is annotated as a component of the cytosolic large ribosomal subunit; no secretion signal or membrane topology is indicated by the sequence analysis.
